Higher stability is source example, no speed-only change without resident strength/equipment/actual gait assessment. Affected-side rear helper and needed torso/waist support, initial good-side support reason, individualized support amount and practical training retained.

Step-up cane→good-foot→affected-foot; down cane→affected-foot→good-foot. Worker on lower step, behind up/front down is contextual example, not universal fixed one-step prescription. Handrail/step/cane/ability checks; remembered foot order omits cane/helper/environment; learning text not untrained procedure. No forced shape under unsuitable loading/joints; unwell/insufficient support means seek help/professional confirmation.

Chair good-side/stopped brake plus good-hand support/affected-knee support and chair/floor checks retained.

Far armrest with good hand→torso forward/rise→turn toward chair→sit remains example; separate stages supported per ability/method, no independent standing/pivoting of non-weight-bearing person. Deep seating/foot support followed by feeling/condition check; actual appropriate depth/body support/feet/hands/clothing and comfort/slide observations tied to plan.

Before pushing: foot-support usability and hands/clothing wheel entrapment check; good hand armrest/affected hand inside adapted to sustainable posture/equipment. Curb stop/explanation; tipping lever foot and handles diagonally downward lift front; front wheels gently on step then rear up. Distinguish force arrow/travel direction/front-rear contact sequence/lifting versus landing, no increased-force arbitrary-curb inference.

Steep downhill backward example prevents resident forward slide; worker rear safety/feet front-back support position. Actual passability/method depend chair/slope/helper strength+number.
